title: THE INVISIBILITY HYPOTHESIS: PROMISES OF AGI AND THE FUTURE OF THE GLOBAL SOUTH

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and structural analysis projecting the disparate impacts of AGI on the Global South, supported by macro-level global indicators including GDP per capita, political corruption indices, and population distribution.

Conceptual evaluation using the proposed 'Invisibility Hypothesis' to analyze how AI-mediated allocation and governance systems systematically exclude 'economically invisible' informal workers and small-scale producers who lack standardized machine-legibility.
